blocks.text: You might think of cosmetic purposes when you picture getting Botox, like minimizing fine lines. But these injections are used for dental purposes as well! Our dentist in Wyoming, OH, at Wyoming Family Dentistry uses Botox to help ease jaw pain and other symptoms linked to dental issues.

It’s a botulinum toxin given in safe, tiny doses to freeze muscles in the treated area on a short-term basis. This effect stops these muscles from contracting or tightening up, easing tension and preventing soreness.
When You Might Consider Botox at the Dentist’s Office
It might surprise you to know that there are several uses for dental Botox injections. You may want to explore this option for any of the following issues:
How Does Botox Help TMJ Symptoms?

You may consider Botox in Wyoming, OH, if you have a problem with one or both jaw joints or temporomandibular joints (TMJ). These injections can help ease TMJ symptoms, like facial pain and chewing problems.
How Do Botox Injections Help Bruxism?

Do you tend to grind your teeth at night or during the day? This can trigger pain and damage your teeth if it happens often enough. Botox keeps the targeted muscles relaxed, stopping you from clenching or grinding your teeth.
How Can Botox Ease Headaches and Pain?
Do you have tension headaches or soreness from dental problems? Botox injections ease tension in the affected muscles, relieving pain and lowering the risk of headaches.
Yes, as long as a qualified and properly trained dentist administers the injections. Our dentist has this training, providing you with peace of mind that your Botox visits will go smoothly!
How Long Do Botox Results Last?

They last for awhile — but not forever. You may notice results in just a few hours. These results usually last for a few months or more, though you’ll need to set up treatment sessions again to maintain them.

Are you looking for relief from ongoing headaches or other symptoms? At Wyoming Family Dentistry, our dentist offers Botox in Wyoming, OH, to help alleviate soreness and pain while improving your day-to-day life!
